description:
## Goal

Enhance the initiative data model and API to support the dashboard page. Add priority field, expand rollup queries, and add a "needs attention" aggregation endpoint.

## Implementation

### Initiative Schema Changes
- Add `priority` field (int, 1-10, same scale as backlog items) to initiative JSON files in `.vrooli/initiatives/`
- Add optional `target_date` field (ISO-8601 string) for time-sensitive initiatives
- Update initiative create/update handlers to accept and validate new fields
- Update CLI `initiatives create` and `initiatives update` commands
- Backfill existing initiatives with default priority (5)

### Enhanced Rollup API
The existing `InitiativeWithRollup` type needs expansion. Current rollup only has item counts by status. Add:
- **Progress metrics:** completed/total items ratio
- **Next unblocked item:** highest-priority unblocked item in the initiative
- **Blocked summary:** which items are blocked and what they're blocked by
- **Status distribution:** count of items in each status (backlog, researching, ready, queued, in_progress, completed, failed, archived)

### Needs Attention Endpoint
New endpoint: `GET /api/v1/dashboard/attention`
Aggregates across all initiatives:
- Failed executions needing review
- Workshop rounds with unresolved decisions
- Items in needs_fixup status
- Items with stale status (in_progress for too long)
Returns a prioritized list of items needing human action.

### Overview Endpoint Enhancement
Expand `swarm-manager overview` to include initiative priorities and new rollup fields.

## Key Files

- Initiative store: `scenarios/swarm-manager/.vrooli/initiatives/*.json`
- Initiative handler: `scenarios/swarm-manager/api/internal/backlog/handler.go` (initiative CRUD)
- Initiative types: `scenarios/swarm-manager/api/internal/backlog/types.go`
- Domain types: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/types/domain.ts` (InitiativeWithRollup)
- Backlog service: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/services/backlog-service.ts`
- CLI: `scenarios/swarm-manager/cli/cmd_backlog.go` (initiatives commands)
- Proto: `packages/proto/schemas/swarm-manager/v1/api/backlog.proto`

title: Add Priority Field to Initiatives and Expand Rollup/Aggregation APIs
